Container.Name: Forgejo
Container.Overview:
Forgejo is a self-hosted lightweight software forge - a community-governed hard fork of Gitea, published by the non-profit Codeberg e.V. It provides Git repositories, issues, pull requests, a wiki, a package/container registry, Git LFS, and Forgejo Actions (CI/CD compatible with GitHub Actions YAML).
SETUP: After first start, open the WebUI on port 3000 and complete the initial installation wizard. Set the Server Domain and Base URL to your external hostname, enable Git LFS, create your admin account, and disable open registration for a private instance.
NOTE: Forgejo does not use a rolling 'latest' tag by design. This template is pinned to major version 16. To move to the next major version, manually edit the tag in Repository. See https://forgejo.org/faq/

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: HTTP port for the Forgejo web interface. Host 3100 avoids a conflict with GluetunVPN which already publishes 3000 on Tower05.

Config.Name: SSH Port
Config.Description: Git over SSH. Host port 2222 avoids Unraid's own SSH (22) and the GluetunVPN port range on Tower05.

Config.Name: Data Path
Config.Description: Persistent storage for repositories, the SQLite database, configuration (app.ini), LFS objects, and attachments. Back up this directory regularly.

Config.Name: Timezone (host)
Config.Description: Mounts the host timezone file so container timestamps match the Unraid timezone.

Config.Name: User ID
Config.Description: User ID for file permissions (99 = nobody on Unraid).

Config.Name: Group ID
Config.Description: Group ID for file permissions (100 = users on Unraid).
